{{Top|leg}}
'''The Commons''' was a grassy park at the center of the city of [[Ussa]], on [[Bellassa/Legends|Bellassa]]. As the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was nearing its final days, the Commons served as meeting place for the Ussan citizens to relax. With the occupation by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces, the Commons was largely covered by the new garrison building.
